summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal advisories and corporate earnings in the retail sector, reflecting ongoing market dynamics and regulatory scrutiny.

bullets.text: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised OnEMI Technology Solutions on a ₹832 crore fundraise.
C&S Partners advised Dr. Lal PathLabs on acquiring a 70% stake in SN Genelab.
ITC reported a 20% decline in standalone net profit for Q2 despite a 45% increase in revenue.
Apple achieved all-time September quarter revenue records in India, according to CEO John Ternus.
Gold smuggling in India surged to 50 tonnes in Q3 2026, up from 3 tonnes a year earlier, according to the World Gold Council.
